Source [S7] lists 'Mathematical functions computing the signed distance for basic geometric primitives' and provides specific SDF formulas for Sphere, Box, Cylinder, Cone, Plane, and Torus. Source [S1] provides code and notes on 'Basic Signed Distance Functions' for Sphere, Box, and Torus. All sources confirm that these primitives are analytical functions used to compute the signed distance to the surface of the respective shapes.
